theme: Mark Hanna 1896 — the cartoon you've seen, the name you don't know.
withheld: William Jennings Bryan (named only as 'a thirty-six year old preacher')
Hanna's Cleveland origin / Rhodes marriage / coal-iron empire

clips.narration: The cartoon ran in every Hearst paper in America.
clips.motion: slow push-in (Ken Burns 1.0 -> 1.05) on dollar-sign suit
clips.hint_logic: Names a phenomenon (cartoon) without naming the subject.

clips.narration: The caption changed every week. The man did not.
clips.hint_logic: Suggests a sustained press campaign; doesn't say what for.

clips.visual: assets/hanna-portrait.jpg on Ink Black; name in Playfair Display 900 (Newsprint Cream)
clips.hint_logic: Name lands like an indictment but explains nothing.

clips.narration: And in eighteen ninety-six, he did something no one had ever done at that scale.
clips.visual: 1896 numerals fill frame, Blood Oxide #C03A2C, IBM Plex Mono 400px
clips.hint_logic: Drops year + claim, withholds the act.

clips.narration: He turned the American presidential election into a corporate purchase order.
clips.hint_logic: Names the genre of the crime; not the buyers, sellers, or winner.

clips.narration: Three and a half million dollars raised. Twenty times what his opponent spent.
clips.visual: $3,500,000 Hanna Amber #C87533 count-up; '20x' Blood Oxide stamp on cut
clips.motion: tabular-num count-up over 800ms; stamp in on word 'twenty'

clips.narration: Standard Oil, two hundred and fifty thousand dollars. JP Morgan, two hundred and fifty thousand dollars.
clips.visual: stacked ledger lines, IBM Plex Mono: 'STANDARD OIL — $250,000' then 'JP MORGAN — $250,000'
clips.motion: lines type in left-aligned, hairline rule between, total line stays blank
clips.hint_logic: Names donors; hides the recipient and what the money bought.

clips.narration: Half a million voters, transported by train, to shake one man's hand.
clips.hint_logic: The 'one man' is McKinley — deliberately never shown.

clips.narration: The opposition had a thirty-six year old preacher who could move a crowd to tears.
clips.visual: newsprint paper texture, no portrait; floating caption '— the opposition'
clips.hint_logic: Bryan unnamed. Viewers can't search forward to the outcome.

clips.motion: vignette closes hard; cut to black
clips.hint_logic: Closes on the instrument. Not on what it did. Curiosity gap intact.

alternates_held_in_reserve.narration: Banks assessed at a quarter of a percent of capital.
Two hundred million pieces of campaign literature, printed and mailed.
He wasn't born with money. He was born in a grocery.
